title: cirsium acaule subsp. esculentum
intro: Cirsium acaule subsp. esculentum, commonly known as edible thistle, is a subspecies of the plant Cirsium acaule, belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its edible stalks and leaves, which have been used in traditional medicine for their health benefits. The edible thistle is rich in antioxidants and has been traditionally used to treat digestive issues and inflammation, attributed to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Cirsium acaule subsp. esculentum include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
